title: World Bank Global Administrative Boundaries
description: High-resolution, World Bank-approved global administrative boundaries covering Admin 0 (countries), Admin 1 (states/provinces), and Admin 2 (counties/districts) levels, plus Non-Determined Legal Status Areas (NDLSA) and an ocean mask. A visualization line file for Admin 0 and supplementary data dictionaries joinable to Admin 1 and 2 features are included as separate downloads.
